        Report Description
      
      
        Report Id: 521
        Report Name: Sales - Bill Wise Item Detailed
        Description: 
          
        Amt With Tax = Item Quantity * Item Rate
        Total Amt = Amount after applying discount and (inclusive or exclusive) of taxes and all the charges which are to be collected from the customer.
        The delivery charge and round off value are not considered in this report.
